nom: Minimalist AHA BHA 10% Daily Exfoliator for Beginners

avis.texte: So, the bottle came a bit empty and since Ive never encountered this brand before I cant tell if this is normal for the brand. Mine also came almost expired with a month to spare. Kinda burns the skin even with a small amount but I did notice a change in some of my texture since using it.

I was excited to try this lactic acidosis combined with glycolic acid on my scar tissue. I usually use glycolic acid on my face so this was a bonus. As soon as I put it on the first time I knew it wasn’t as strong as it says on the bottle. My glycolic acid same percentage from another company has a slight burn feel to it and the next morning I have no pimples or clogged pores. This didn’t feel like anything and I got pimples and clogged pores. I tested my bottle of straight glycolic acid again and it worked fine so it wasn’t anything hormonal it’s the actual product is really weak.

avis.titre: Effective but gentle for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin - even when using expensive and/or organic/“clean” products. I also have rosacea and periocular dermatitis. All said, very difficult time finding exfoliators that work well for me. This is fantastic. Makes my skin feel and look super clean - legitimately exfoliates - reduces appearance of pores and zero inflammation or irritation.

avis.titre: Works for oily acne prone skin
avis.texte: This product is a must have in my skin care routine for the last 3 years. I have oily acne prone and large pores. 2 days a week I use it as an exfoliating mask on bare clean skin for 20 minutes then apply moisturizer on top and go to sleep. My skin usually looks radiant within 36-48 hours. I also gift to people who have similar skin to mine
I use for 30 min on my clean dried face. And wash it with water. May not be good for sensitive skin. Avoid if on topical retinoids.
I really like this serum. It helped my skin look clearer and smooth. It isn't too oily either and has a nice consistency.
Excellent chemical exfoliation. It absorbs well into the skin snd doesn’t burn or irritate as some acids can. Will definitely repurchase.
Super great job at making my skin feel good and helps with my pores

Used it for the first time the other night and the next morning, my skin felt very different. I suffer with dry skin and its hard to find anything that lasts that helps make my skin feel supple or fresh. After first use already my skin felt better. I found my mosturiser was still fresh and hadn't dried out the next morning. It has to be the serum, because my mosturiser has usually dried up by the morning. This is my first impressions of it anyway. I will be buying more.
definitely works. need to hide it from sunlight and use sunscreen the next day.
Perfect for sensitive & beginner skin. Cleared up dullness and minor congestion without stinging or peeling. Use 2x a week for best results but everyone is different.
Received expired product, I did a purchase in jan 2026, i received a product with mfg date july 2023, product says 18 months from mfg date.

avis.titre: Missing like a quarter of product
avis.texte: Not sure about the effectiveness of this product but I'm not thrilled about how much is missing from the bottle.
It says on the bottle use before the end of 18 moths from mfg date. which is 07/23 so the product i got came already expired!
I will update one I receive a properly sealed product and use it.
